name: Alistair Davies
bio:
Alistair's motorsport journey began unexpectedly during a university internship at a small Formula Ford team. Initially tasked with data analysis, he quickly demonstrated an aptitude for understanding the intricacies of vehicle dynamics and aerodynamics. This passion led him to pursue a Master's degree in Motorsport Engineering, followed by a decade of experience in various roles, from race engineer to lead aerodynamicist, before settling into the Technical Director role.

Alistair is known for his data-driven approach, blending quantitative analysis with intuition gained from years on the track. He emphasizes clear communication and collaboration within the team, ensuring that every member understands their role in achieving the overall performance goals. He's a firm believer in incremental improvements, constantly seeking small gains that compound into significant results.

What sets Alistair apart is his ability to remain calm and focused under pressure. He thrives in the dynamic environment of motorsport, making critical decisions in real-time to optimize performance. This, coupled with his keen eye for talent and ability to mentor younger engineers, makes him a valuable asset to any team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted with a slight wave
physical.description: Alistair has a lean build and an intense gaze that reflects his analytical mind.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on drinking Earl Grey tea at precisely 10:00 AM every morning.
